description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Kasikote, Ambanpola D/S Division, Kurunegala District - (25/0172)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of specific land parcels with their locations, extents, ownership details (all listed as "The State"), and land classifications. The content falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements for multiple parcels across different villages and cadastral maps.
